value.answer: Sorry you're looking for that, it's a big step. Quick version: if you have an extended health plan through work, private therapists are often covered, and your employer's EAP may include a few free sessions a year. Private therapy isn't covered by OHIP, though. Free or low-cost options in Toronto: Ontario Structured Psychotherapy (free short-term CBT if you're dealing with depression or anxiety), Family Service Toronto (fees based on income), and BounceBack Ontario if you're 15 or older and want guided self-help. Psychotherapy Referral Service can match you with a registered psychotherapist, and First Session offers free consultations. If things get urgent, ConnexOntario is free and open 24 hours at 1-866-531-2600, and they can point you to the right service.
